protocol_document.note: The cell's registered protocol document is the v3 package's own, unchanged: the recovery moves the seal path in the code, never the protocol. Its bytes are pinned by the sealed root decision slurp-b2-samples5-anchor-v3-admission-v1 and are not edited; the addendum is docs/readiness/2026-09-17-slurp-b2-samples5-anchor-v3-recovery-v1.md.

quality_read_gate: Structural only. The four-row smoke takes no answer, reference or quality read of any kind: contact counts inside the 19-contact ceiling, the episode receipt's role_visits and planner_routes, solver_group custody of all five raw samples with their five distinct seeds, the E2d commit_params field, exactly one kind=phase:solver state per Solver visit carrying the committed answer, the offline commit replay, one fit receipt per realized contact, and a clean seal through the bundle verifier under invariant I7g. No scorer runs. The FAILED attempt SAEA-SLURP-NATIVE-SAMPLES5-ANCHOR-SMOKE-4-V3 was never scored and no partial quality read of its four generated rows was taken or is permitted. Cell B2's own quality gate is unchanged and belongs to the arm: no task-quality read before the complete sealed manifest, the exact ordered 1,080 outputs each carrying its solver_group custody, the native phase summary and the single successful complete official TRAIN score all exist.

Neither run id nor either attempt id is ever reused.
recovery.fix: E2d (commit f3a77fb0, merged 5492c2af): reproduction.ojw.native_group_solver records solver_group.commit_params; core.flight.runtime._canonical_output_rows binds a grouped row's response_text_sha256 to the DELIVERED bytes; rails.native_episode_receipt validates the new field; and core.bundle.outputs adds invariant I7g, which binds every raw sample to the trace's own MODEL_RESPONSE bytes, resolves the named commit policy in core.base.COMMIT_POLICIES and re-derives the delivered bytes through analysis.native_commit_replay. I7 is unchanged; a samples-1 row is byte-identical to before.
recovery.one_recovery_only: The v3 preregistration section 10 allows at most one root-diagnosed recovery re-registration. This is it; a second failure closes cell B2, and the fix must then be proven on a four-row dry run before another mechanism is admitted.
recovery.root_cause: The four-row smoke generated all 36 of its contacts and then FAILED AT THE SEAL: core.bundle.outputs refused row slurp:train:000007:audio--1504197557 with invariant I7, "text does not match its recorded response_text_sha256 -- the text was mutated after the model response was recorded (I7)". A grouped Solver row's delivered text is the registered commit policy's aggregate over the five raw samples and equals none of them, while the pre-E2d runner bound the row's response_text_sha256 to the LAST RAW sample's text hash.
